# Third-party software

The archived checkpoints use the iTransformer architecture developed by THUML.
The upstream project is available at:

`https://github.com/thuml/iTransformer`

The original project is MIT licensed. Its license is preserved in
`third_party/iTransformer/LICENSE`. The compact implementation in
`src/reefformer/itransformer.py` contains only the components required to load
the archived checkpoints and retains compatible module names.

No DLinear or PatchTST source code is redistributed in this repository.
